title: Cross-dataset de-duplication avoids double-counting overlapping sources
evidence: query.go:33 DB.Unique() merges same home/away pair within 36h across the 5 match CSVs; TestNoDoubleCounting (soccer_test.go:233) asserts 38 league games per team

title: Team-name normalization handles accents, state suffixes and aliases

title: Acceptance tests are coupled to concrete dataset values (brittle)
evidence: soccer_test.go:106 asserts exact 'Flamengo - 90 pts (28W, 6D, 4L', soccer_test.go:186 asserts 'Neymar Jr - Overall: 92'; atdd_review score 0.5714 flags this (_atdd_review.json)
